name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: For Rc::<T>::from_raw(ptr) to be safe, if U or U's data pointer from the originating Rc::<U>::into_raw call is not T but has the same size and alignment, the reference reinterpretation must satisfy validity requirements for both the original reference type and the reference-to-T type.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Rc < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
